let counter = 0;

const ALLOWED = new Set(['title', 'description', 'priority']);
const PRIORITIES = new Set(['low', 'normal', 'high']);

export async function listTools() {
  return [{
    name: 'ticket_create',
    description: 'Create a support ticket with a non-empty title and description and an optional priority.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        title: { type: 'string', description: 'A short, non-empty summary of the issue.' },
        description: { type: 'string', description: 'A detailed, non-empty description of the issue.' },
        priority: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'normal', 'high'], description: 'Ticket priority. Defaults to "normal".' }
      },
      required: ['title', 'description'],
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }];
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'ticket_create') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    throw new Error('Arguments must be an object');
  }
  const extras = Object.keys(args).filter(k => !ALLOWED.has(k));
  if (extras.length) {
    throw new Error(`Unexpected field(s): ${extras.join(', ')}`);
  }
  const { title, description, priority } = args;
  if (typeof title !== 'string' || title.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('title is required and must be a non-empty string');
  }
  if (typeof description !== 'string' || description.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('description is required and must be a non-empty string');
  }
  const resolvedPriority = priority === undefined ? 'normal' : priority;
  if (!PRIORITIES.has(resolvedPriority)) {
    throw new Error('priority must be one of: low, normal, high');
  }
  const id = `t${++counter}`;
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Created ticket ${id} (${resolvedPriority})` }]
  };
}

export function _reset() {
  counter = 0;
}
